stem.text: But-2-ene reacts with cold dilute acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ to give product X.
But-2-ene reacts with an excess of hot concentrated acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ to give product Y.
Which statement about X and Y is correct?

A.text: Only one of X and Y reacts with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine.

B.text: X and Y both react with sodium hydroxide.

C.text: X and Y both react with sodium metal.

D.text: Y reacts with $\text{LiAlH}_4$ to give X.
